items.q: I've never lifted before. Is this for me?
items.a: Yes. Every strength class is coached and capped at 14, so a coach can see your form and adjust your weights. Premium also includes our beginner workshops, where we go through the main lifts step by step before you do them in class.

items.q: I've just had a baby. Can I come?
items.a: Yes. Mums and bubs classes are capped at 10 and bub comes with you. There's a fenced area with toys on the studio floor, and prams stay in the waiting area. Before you start, everyone fills in a pre-exercise screening. If something in your answers needs it, we may ask for clearance from your doctor first.
Monday to Friday, yes. On Saturdays, HIIT is open to a training partner of any gender, so you can bring someone and train doubles.

items.a: Yes. You choose a minimum term of 12 weeks or 6 months, and your fee won't go up during it. After that your membership keeps going at the same rate until you cancel with 28 days' written notice (email is fine). You also have 3 business days to cool off after signing.

items.q: What if I need to stop during my minimum term?
items.a: If you move more than 100km away, interstate or overseas, or become permanently unable to train, there's no exit fee. You can also transfer your membership to someone else for $30. Otherwise the early exit fee is $200 or four weeks' fees, whichever is less.

items.q: How old do I need to be?
items.a: 16 or over. If you're 16 or 17, a parent or guardian signs your agreement with you.
